  SELECT ID, card_scheme, fixed_amount, rate, merchant_category_code
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees`
  WHERE ARRAY_LENGTH(merchant_category_code) > 0
),
exploded AS (
  SELECT r.ID, r.card_scheme, mcc, r.fixed_amount + r.rate * 100.0 / 10000 AS fee_100_eur
  FROM fee_rules r, UNNEST(r.merchant_category_code) AS mcc
)
SELECT e.mcc, m.description, COUNT(*) AS n_rules,
       ROUND(AVG(e.fee_100_eur), 4) AS avg_fee_100_eur,

FROM exploded e
LEFT JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.merchant_category_codes` m ON m.mcc = e.mcc
GROUP BY e.mcc, m.description
ORDER BY avg_fee_100_eur DESC
LIMIT 20

WITH all_mcc AS (
  SELECT mcc FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.merchant_category_codes`
),
rules AS (
  SELECT ID, fixed_amount, rate, merchant_category_code,
         fixed_amount + rate * 100.0 / 10000 AS fee_100_eur
  FROM `<gcp-project>.dabstep.fees`
),
applicable AS (
  -- explicit MCC match
  SELECT a.mcc, r.fee_100_eur
  FROM rules r
  JOIN all_mcc a ON a.mcc IN UNNEST(r.merchant_category_code)
  UNION ALL
  -- wildcard rules (empty MCC list) apply to every MCC
  SELECT a.mcc, r.fee_100_eur
  FROM rules r
  CROSS JOIN all_mcc a
  WHERE ARRAY_LENGTH(r.merchant_category_code) = 0
)
SELECT ap.mcc, m.description, COUNT(*) AS n_rules,
       ROUND(AVG(ap.fee_100_eur), 4) AS avg_fee_100_eur,
       ROUND(MAX(ap.fee_100_eur), 4) AS max_fee_100_eur
FROM applicable ap
LEFT JOIN `<gcp-project>.dabstep.merchant_category_codes` m ON m.mcc = ap.mcc
GROUP BY ap.mcc, m.description
ORDER BY avg_fee_100_eur DESC
LIMIT 15
